cases.prompt: A live-action IMAX-scale aerial shot races through clouds over hundreds of bronze celestial warships and endless heavenly soldiers toward the South Heavenly Gate, where Sun Wukong stands alone.

assertions.description: A large celestial invasion force with multiple bronze warships, soldiers, and war banners is visible at monumental scale.
A colossal traditional Chinese heavenly gate and palace complex dominates the destination of the camera move.
One lone armored monkey warrior with a crimson cape and long staff stands on the white-jade stairs facing the army.
The shot has readable foreground, middle ground, and deep background with convincing blockbuster scale rather than undifferentiated particles.
No subtitle, logo, watermark, or malformed text is visible.
